definition_zh: 贴切的；恰当的；切合时宜的
definition_en: exactly suitable to the situation; apt and fitting
core_image: 摆到正对的位置：一块拼图严丝合缝地放进缺口
scene: 辩论进入僵局，导师轻声点出一句古语。Her apposite remark dissolved the tension in the room.
sceneCN: 这里 apposite 是「贴切的、切中要害的」（第 1 个义项：正合适的话）；句意为：她一句贴切的话化解了房间里的紧张。

derivatives.zh: 加副词后缀 -ly，义为「贴切地；恰当地」
加名词后缀 -ness，义为「贴切；恰当」
同根名词，义为「同位；并置」
同根近形词，义为「相反的；对立面」

senses.title: Exactly fitting the moment
senses.definition: saying or choosing exactly what the situation calls for
senses.definitionCN: 所说的或所选的正合当下情境所需
senses.example: His apposite reply ended the quarrel.
senses.exampleCN: 他一句恰到好处的回答终结了争吵。
senses.why: Placed right against the situation, the word or act fits its slot perfectly.
senses.whyCN: 正对着情境摆放，话语或行为就严丝合缝地嵌进它的位置。

senses.title: Apt for the subject
senses.definition: closely relevant to the matter under discussion
senses.definitionCN: 与所讨论的主题紧密相关
senses.example: She chose an apposite example to prove the point.
senses.exampleCN: 她选了一个贴切的例子来证明观点。
senses.why: What is set beside the argument and matches it counts as apposite.
senses.whyCN: 摆在论点旁边并能与之匹配的，就是贴切的。

senses.title: Well chosen
senses.definition: selected with precision and good judgment
senses.example: The title is short and apposite.
senses.why: Placing requires judgment; good placement is good choice.
senses.whyCN: 摆放需要判断，摆得好即选得好。

senses.title: Fitting a person's character
senses.definition: suitable to someone's nature or style
senses.definitionCN: 与某人的本性或风格相配
senses.example: The award is apposite for a poet of restraint.
senses.exampleCN: 这个奖对一位克制的诗人来说正相宜。
senses.why: The fit is checked against a person, not just a topic.
senses.whyCN: 匹配的对象不止话题，还可以是一个人。

senses.title: Coming at the right time
senses.definition: occurring at the most useful or effective moment
senses.definitionCN: 出现在最有效、最有用的时刻
senses.example: An apposite question broke the silence.
senses.exampleCN: 一个来得正好的提问打破了沉默。
senses.why: Placement extends into time: the right slot can be a moment.
senses.whyCN: 摆放延伸到时间维度：正确的位置也可以是正确的时刻。

senses.title: Grammatically in apposition
senses.definition: standing next to a noun to rename or describe it
senses.definitionCN: 紧邻名词、对其重述或描述
senses.example: In 'my friend the doctor', the doctor is apposite to my friend.
senses.exampleCN: 在「my friend the doctor」中，the doctor 与 my friend 构成同位。
senses.why: The oldest sense: two words set side by side as equals.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：两个词并排而立、互为印证。

senses.title: Contrast with the merely similar
senses.definition: emphasizing exact fit rather than loose resemblance
senses.definitionCN: 强调严丝合缝的匹配而非泛泛的相似
senses.example: The metaphor is not just close; it is apposite.
senses.exampleCN: 这个比喻不止相近，而是贴切。
senses.why: Only a piece cut to shape can sit opposite its slot with nothing left over.
senses.whyCN: 只有按形状裁好的拼块才能正对缺口、不多不少。

senses.title: Marking critical judgment
senses.definition: praising the discernment shown in a fitting choice or remark
senses.definitionCN: 称赞在恰当选择或言辞中显现的眼力
senses.example: Critics admired his apposite taste in allusions.
senses.exampleCN: 评论者称赞他运用典故的眼光精准。
senses.why: Recognizing the exact slot is a skill, so the word carries praise.
senses.whyCN: 认出正确位置是一种功力，因此这个词自带褒义。

intro.en: Apposite comes from Latin appositus, set near or placed against, the past participle of apponere.
intro.cn: apposite 来自拉丁语 appositus（置于近旁、正对摆放），是 apponere 的过去分词。

items.en: The reconstructed root *apo- with *sin- gave Latin ponere, to put or place.
items.cn: 重构词根组合衍生出拉丁语 ponere（放置）。

items.en: Ap- (toward) plus ponere (place) formed apponere, to set beside or against.
items.cn: ap-（朝向）加 ponere（放置）构成 apponere，意为置于一旁或正对。

items.en: Appositus meant placed near; in grammar it described nouns set side by side.
items.cn: appositus 意为放在近旁；在语法中描述并置的名词。

items.en: English borrowed apposite in the sixteenth century, first for grammatical apposition, then for fitness of remark.
items.cn: 英语十六世纪借入 apposite，先用于语法同位，后转指言辞的贴切。

items.en: It now chiefly praises remarks, examples, and choices that fit exactly.
items.cn: 如今主要用来称赞严丝合缝的言辞、例子与选择。

note.en: Apposite is famously confusable with opposite, and sits near aptness words.
note.cn: apposite 极易与 opposite 混淆，并与「贴切」类词相邻。

entries.definitionCN: 相反的；对面的——只是拼写相近，词源同根而义转向

entries.definition: placing two nouns side by side as one unit
a noun phrase renaming another beside it

normalIntro.en: Fix apposite by contrasting it with its twin opposite.
normalIntro.cn: 用孪生词 opposite 来对照记牢 apposite。

normal.en: apposite = ap- (toward) + pos (place) + -ite: placed right against.
normal.cn: apposite = ap-（朝向）+ pos（放）+ -ite：正对着放。

normal.en: opposite is the contrast twin: placed against in conflict.
normal.cn: opposite 是对照孪生词：对立地摆放。

normal.en: Same pos root as position, compose, deposit.
normal.cn: 与 position、compose、deposit 同属 pos 词根。

normal.en: Grammar link: an appositive is set apposite to a noun.
normal.cn: 语法关联：同位语与名词并置（apposite）。

normal.en: Meaning shortcut: apposite = apt + opposite's spelling.
normal.cn: 义记捷径：apposite ≈ apt（贴切）+ opposite（拼写）。

abstract.en: A puzzle piece clicks into its exact slot — nothing forced.
abstract.cn: 拼图块咔哒一声进入正确缺口——毫不费力。

abstract.en: Two statues placed face to face: opposite faces, apposite fits.
abstract.cn: 两尊雕像面对面摆放：opposite 相对，apposite 相配。

abstract.en: Apposite sounds like 'a pose it': the remark strikes the perfect pose.
abstract.cn: apposite 听着像 a pose it：这句话摆出了最完美的姿势。

examples.en: She offered an apposite quotation from Cicero.
examples.cn: 她引用了一句西塞罗的贴切名言。

examples.en: The timing of his joke was apposite.
examples.cn: 他玩笑的时机拿捏得恰到好处。

examples.en: Choose an apposite title for the essay.
examples.cn: 为文章选一个精当的标题。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿宝 sit」——阿宝一坐就坐上正对的位置，坐得贴切，谐音仅助记。

root: 拉丁词根 pon-/pos-（放置）：apposite 由 ap-（朝向）+ ponere（放置）构成，本义「正对着摆放」，引申为话语、例子与情境严丝合缝，即贴切；与 opposite（对立摆放）同根。

sensesIntro.en: From exact placement, apposite grows into fitting the moment, the subject, a good choice, a person's style, the right timing, grammatical apposition, exactness versus resemblance, and praised discernment.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「精准摆放」出发，apposite 生长出切合情境、切合主题、精当选材、合乎气质、时机正好、语法同位、严合胜于相似以及眼力受赞。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a piece set exactly against its slot
core.cn: 核心意象：一块拼图正对着放进它的缺口

branches.en: fit in space and in time: the right word at the right moment
branches.cn: 空间与时间中的契合：在正确时刻说正确的话

branches.en: exact relevance, sharper than loose similarity
branches.cn: 精准相关，胜过泛泛相似

branches.en: judgment rewarded: good choices earn the label
branches.cn: 被褒奖的判断力：好的选择赢得此词

branches.en: fit checked against a person's nature
branches.cn: 以人的气质为标准的匹配

branches.en: the grammatical root: words set side by side

intro.en: Apposite belongs to the enormous pos-family of placing words.
intro.cn: apposite 属于庞大的 pos「放置」词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin ponere, to put or place, powers position, compose, deposit, and dozens more.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ponere（放置）支撑着 position、compose、deposit 等几十个词。

derivatives.zh: 同根名词，义为「同位；并置」
